A file downloaded on the host and kept only if its SHA-256 matches.

```hcl
step "example" {
  download {
    dest = "..."
    sha256 = "..."
    url = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dest` | string | Yes | Absolute path to save it to. |
| `group` | string | No | Group. |
| `mode` | string | No | Octal permissions. Defaults to "0644". |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "forget" (default) leaves the file, "delete" removes it. |
| `owner` | string | No | Owner. |
| `sha256` | string | Yes | Expected SHA-256, in lowercase hex. |
| `url` | string | Yes | http or https URL. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_download.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the file is there with the right checksum. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_download` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
